assets.label: pressure relief devices
assets.service: overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system

control_failures.control_label: control of freeboard, beach width and decant

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - permit to work records incomplete for PSV-4111

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control IMPOUNDMENT_FREEBOARD_CONTROL: the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the control of freeboard, beach width and decant on PSV-4111 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating an impoundment, specifically inspecting embankments and instrumentation. PSV-4111 (pressure relief devices) is in service for overpressure protection on the transfer and storage system. The task proceeded during a statutory inspection while the control of freeboard, beach width and decant was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 26 April 2020 a planned critical control verification of PSV-4111 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the control of freeboard, beach width and decant not effective.
